original_value: Novalume PrismDesk 27 is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for studio color work and everyday productivity. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, built-in anti-glare coating, and a fully adjustable stand. Connectivity includes HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C with 65W power delivery. The display is aimed at creators who want a bright, wide-gamut screen in a compact workspace.
